Part I, Line 1. Enter the tax credit amount allocated from the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee (C T C A C)
Line 2. Pass through credit from Schedule K-1 (100S, 541, 565 or 568). See instructions
Line 3. Credit carryover from prior year(s). See Instructions
Line 4. Total available credit. Add lines 1 through line 3
Line 5a. Credit Claimed. Enter the amount of the credit claimed on the current year tax return. See instructions. (Do not include any assigned credit claimed on form F T B 3544, Part B)
Line 5b. Total credit assigned. Enter the total amount from form F T B 3544, Part A, column (g). If you are not a corporation, enter 0. See instructions
Line 5c. Credit amount to be elected as refundable in future years. See instructions
Line 6. Credit carryover available for future years. Add line 5a, 5b, and 5c subtract the result from line 4
Part II, Line 7. Credit recapture. See Instructions
